# plumpose

> Luxury silk sleepwear designed in Doha, Qatar. 22 momme silk pyjama sets with a hand-drawn whale-shark print, carefully hand-finished, with optional hand embroidery. Prices are in Qatari riyals (QAR); delivery across Qatar, the GCC and worldwide.

The pieces are designed in Doha; they are not made there. Every order is charged in QAR, whatever currency a visitor browses in.

## Shop

- [The collection](https://plumpose.com/shop): all pieces, with prices and sizes
- [Al Shaheen Nights — Silk Pyjama Set](https://plumpose.com/products/al-shaheen-nights): the whale-shark print set, sizes XS to XL, with hand embroidery available
- [Size guide](https://plumpose.com/size-guide): garment measurements in centimetres, and UK, US, EU, Australian and Japanese sizes
